research_question: What mechanisms are used to preserve, revalidate, authorize, constrain, verify, or restore decision validity in agentic AI systems?
analysis_sources: v102 mechanism taxonomy; v103 mechanism prevalence

research_question: At which decision-to-effect boundaries are these mechanisms positioned?
objective: Map decision-validity evidence to validity loci from decision formation through post-effect closure.
analysis_sources: v102 primary boundary; v105 evidence architecture
primary_measure: Five validity loci; primary boundary per record

research_question: How does demonstrated evidence differ from architectural/conceptual evidence across mechanisms and validity loci?
objective: Differentiate CORE from CORE_REVIEW evidence and quantify the evidence gradient.
analysis_sources: v103 prevalence; v104 Fisher exact/sensitivity; v105 locus coverage

research_question: How mature and domain-general is the current decision-validity evidence base?
objective: Assess implementation maturity and application-domain concentration.
analysis_sources: v103 maturity/domain distributions; v104 domain concentration

research_question: Where are the principal evidence gaps across the decision-to-effect lifecycle?
objective: Identify loci/mechanisms for which conceptual attention exceeds demonstrated evidence, especially consequential execution and post-effect closure.
analysis_sources: v103 evidence-gap analysis; v104 robustness; v105 gap map

research_question: How can the heterogeneous evidence be organized into a defensible synthesis framework without claiming invention of existing governance controls?
objective: Develop an evidence-mapped Decision-Validity Architecture and delimit its novelty relative to adjacent frameworks.
analysis_sources: v105 architecture; v106 novelty stress-test; v107 frozen contribution position
